The '''Valrar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valrar]]. It was under control of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn's confederation|confederation]] as of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].
